primary_review.scope: Read-only primary-source review of ICC structural deltas; not a complete ICC/PDF-A conformance assertion.

D50.v2_evidence: ICC.1:2001-04 Table9 p12 and A.1 p65 require D50 (X0.9642 Y1.0000 Z0.8249); numeric types5.3.3/5.3.10 define fixed signed16fractional bits but no unique hexadecimal D50 encoding or general quantization rule.
D50.v43_evidence: ICC.1:2010 7.2.16 p23 gives decimal D50 as XYZNumber, not a unique hex triplet.
D50.v44_evidence: ICC.1:2022 7.2.16 p23 explicitly applies rounding to four decimal places.
D50.v44_integer_predicate: For nonnegative fixed-point n: (n*10000+32768)/65536 equals9642,10000,8249 respectively.
D50.corpus_facts: All10 D50 deltas involve the same936byte v2.1 profile with XYZ F6D6/10000/D32C; D32C corresponds to0.82489013671875.
D50.conservative_policy: Exact-triplet mismatch alone is not a proven failure. v4.4 uses the explicit round4 criterion; earlier-edition near-D50 alternatives can remain unknown rather than importing a unique rounding choice.

v2_reserved.evidence: ICC.1:2001-04 Table9 p12 labels84..127 reserved for future expansion without a zero requirement. Explicit zero requirements elsewhere concern version bytes10/11 and tag-type reserved bytes4..7, not this header field. v4 Table17/7.2.19 expressly requires100..127zero.
v2_reserved.corpus_facts: The2 files contain v2.1 profiles with84..99nonzero and100..127zero.
v2_reserved.conservative_policy: v2nonzero reserved header bytes unknown; v4nonzero defined reserved header bytes failed.

size.limit: Existing catalogue failure is not an independent normative oracle. Counted extra LF plus uncounted CRLF differs from a sole uncounted separator. Primary wording may warrant unknown if interpreted as ambiguous; no blanket acceptance of extra decoded ICC bytes established.
